description: Results from the project's original h=3 phase (24-hour input, single-value prediction 3 hours ahead), preserved for the record before the h=3 artifacts were deleted. This is the only comparison where both architectures were trained under matched conditions on that framing -- the current multi-horizon (72h input, 24h output) results in models/comparison/lstm_on_shared_test_split/ and each models/Transformer/exp*/ directory are not comparable to these numbers.
